top.line: Behaviour policies per feature, per fix and per resource, not only per agent or application.

in-short.line: Hand testers the feature's policy; it describes the feature; signed, it makes an attack a path outside it.

feature.line: Test a feature with its behaviour policy, which is also its description; what changed is the policies' difference.
feature.para: A tool can build the test environment.

context.line: The same behaviour is fine in one place and a problem in another; the feature policy carries the context.

enforce.line: Client checks cut the noise; signed policies on requests let server and observers spot paths outside them.

resource.line: A resource behaviour policy is everything a key or API allows; the gap to the feature's needs is the risk.

bugs.line: A fix is a change of behaviour too: the path it closes and what it must not open.

agents.line: Agent and user policies are feature policies plus a workflow; policies become permission sets for custom interfaces.

next.line: First uses: the factory's CI changes and keys injected by host; the ABP agent maps the rest.

limits.line: A proposal; client checks are not a boundary; request signing not built yet.

sources.line: Dictated 19 November 2026, building on application behaviour policies and abp.sgit.ai.
